comment: The expected Marlin mosaic: what a clean build of pattern.yaml gives from the tesserae its two sources make (docs/spec-0.1.md section 11). Each source names a pinned download of manifest.json, the directory inside it, the builder and settings file that read it and the piece it becomes. knowledge_hash is section 3.6; counts, weak_ids and notices are the build report's (section 7.2); conflicts, alias_conflicts and stale_references are how many the report lists, and mentions how many it lists by status and role. Recorded from two clean local builds; these values are the contract, so a change to them needs a reason.
